top_performing_topics: Retail investor traps in common financial instruments (FDs, Nifty dips, Real Estate)
Contrarian wealth-building strategies (discounted holding companies vs. full-price stocks)
Macro-economic warnings impacting middle-class purchasing power
winning_hook_formulas: The 'Warning/Urgency' Formula: [Emoji] + [Actionable Stop] + [Specific Financial Pain Point] (e.g., 'Stop buying X before you check Y')
The 'Hidden Reality' Formula: [Emoji] + [Common Belief] + [Secret Negative Consequence] (e.g., 'Your X is secretly making you poorer every day')
script_directives: Keep total duration strictly between 20-24 seconds to maintain high completion rates.
Eliminate academic jargon; focus on immediate, high-stakes financial consequences (e.g., 'eating your savings' vs 'liquidity surplus').
Use a 'Problem-Solution' structure where the first 5 seconds establish the threat and the remaining 15 seconds provide a specific, actionable pivot.
seo_directives: Use high-intent, negative-sentiment keywords in the title (e.g., 'Trap', 'Stop', 'Loss', 'Discount') to trigger curiosity.
Limit hashtags to 3-4 highly relevant tags (e.g., #StockMarketIndia, #PersonalFinance, #InvestingTips) to avoid algorithmic dilution.
